== Biography ==
Margaret Glasgow, aged nine, was buried on 28 April 1788 at Ramshorn and Blackfriars, Glasgow. The burial index records consumption. Her birth about1779 is derived from her recorded age; the exact birthday and parents are unknown. She had died by the burial date.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1125736&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-scot-opr-bur-1125736], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref><ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FGLASGOW%2FBUR%2F093163&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-gbprs-glasgow-bur-093163], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Parish transcript review,25October2026 ===
The captured profile already cites this exact Ramshorn burial,28April 1788, reference 644/1/60, age 9 and consumption. Its structured 28March 1788 death day is unsupported by that citation. Two Findmypast derivatives describe the same burial; neither establishes an exact death day. Death by 28April 1788 replaces the imported exact claim. The earlier 1783 baptism comparison remains an identity lead only, with no date or parents transferred.

Earlier biography, retained as a superseded account: Margaret was born in 1779.  She passed away in 1788.
